_comment: Hand-authored: Wowhead zone id (AreaTable id, as used by npc pages' g_mapperData) -> in-game uiMapID. build-sets.mjs warns about vendors whose zones are all missing from this table (with the Wowhead URL for each). Resolve ids in game with '/esc findmap <part of the localized name>' — it prints every matching uiMapID with its parent chain, which is what tells homonyms apart (four maps are called Silvermoon City, twelve are called Dalaran). Scenario copies of a city don't need an entry: npcs list several zones and the build takes the first mappable one.
